title: Tom and His Phone
text:
Tom sends many text messages every day. He writes to his friends in the morning and at night. Sometimes he sends a photo of his lunch to his mother.

Yesterday, Tom's phone was broken, so he could not send messages. His friend Anna called him and asked why he was not answering. Today Tom is happy because he has his phone back.

questions.text: How often does Tom send text messages?
Why could Tom not send messages yesterday?
How did Anna probably feel when Tom did not answer?
options: She was angry about the weather

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom from the passage?
options: He likes to stay in touch with people
He does not like his phone
He lives alone and never talks to anyone
He works in a phone shop

vocabulary.definition: short written texts sent from one phone to another
a picture taken with a camera or phone
giving a reply when someone asks or calls

paragraph_translations: Том щодня надсилає багато текстових повідомлень. Він пише друзям вранці і вночі. Іноді він надсилає фото свого обіду мамі.
Вчора телефон Тома був зламаний, тому він не міг надсилати повідомлення. Його подруга Анна зателефонувала і запитала, чому він не відповідає. Сьогодні Том радий, бо знову має свій телефон.
